user.title: Find your school
user.description: Enter the name or city of your Skolengo school.

credentials.title: Sign in to Skolengo
credentials.description: Enter the credentials you normally use to sign in to your school's Skolengo portal.

student.title: Select the student
student.description: Your account is linked to multiple students. Choose the one to track (you can add the others via a new integration entry).

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to Skolengo
reauth_confirm.description: Your session has expired, please sign in again.

birthdate.title: Confirm identity
birthdate.description: Your identity provider asks for the birth date of the pupil {student}. Enter it as DD/MM/YYYY (used only for this sign-in, not stored).

error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach the Skolengo servers.
error.invalid_auth: Incorrect credentials, or the login form for this school isn't supported.
error.no_school_found: No school found for this search.
error.no_student_found: No student found on this account.
error.invalid_birthdate: The birth date entered is not accepted by the identity provider.
error.invalid_birthdate_format: Invalid date, use the DD/MM/YYYY format.

data.alarm_offset: Prep time before the first lesson (minutes)
data.agenda_days_future: Timetable lookahead override (days; leave empty to automatically cover through the end of the school year)
